account_roles_decided_check.name: account_roles_decided_check
account_roles_decided_check.value: ("account_roles"."state" = 'pending' AND "account_roles"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "account_roles"."decided_by" IS NULL) OR ("account_roles"."state" <> 'pending' AND "account_roles"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_roles"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)

account_roles_decided_by_check.name: account_roles_decided_by_check
account_roles_decided_by_check.value: "account_roles"."decided_by" IS NULL OR length("account_roles"."decided_by") BETWEEN 1 AND 256

account_roles_request_email_check.name: account_roles_request_email_check
account_roles_request_email_check.value: "account_roles"."request_email" IS NULL OR length("account_roles"."request_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320

account_roles_grant_email_check.name: account_roles_grant_email_check
account_roles_grant_email_check.value: "account_roles"."grant_email" IS NULL OR ("account_roles"."role" = 'admin' AND char_length("account_roles"."grant_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320)

content_items_prep_all_or_none_check.name: content_items_prep_all_or_none_check
content_items_prep_all_or_none_check.value: ("content_items"."prep_stage" IS NULL AND "content_items"."prep_evidence" IS NULL AND "content_items"."prep_version" IS NULL) OR ("content_items"."prep_stage" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."prep_evidence" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."prep_version" IS NOT NULL)

content_release_items_credit_check.name: content_release_items_credit_check
content_release_items_credit_check.value: "content_release_items"."credit" IS NULL OR length("content_release_items"."credit") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

editorial_items_potd_rule_check.name: editorial_items_potd_rule_check
editorial_items_potd_rule_check.value: "editorial_items"."kind" <> 'plane-of-the-day' OR ("editorial_items"."status" <> 'scheduled' AND "editorial_items"."status" <> 'published') OR "editorial_items"."date_key" IS NOT NULL

media_versions_credit_name_check.name: media_versions_credit_name_check
media_versions_credit_name_check.value: "media_versions"."credit_name" IS NULL OR length("media_versions"."credit_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

media_versions_licence_name_check.name: media_versions_licence_name_check
media_versions_licence_name_check.value: "media_versions"."licence_name" IS NULL OR length("media_versions"."licence_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

media_versions_rights_all_or_none_check.name: media_versions_rights_all_or_none_check
media_versions_rights_all_or_none_check.value: ("media_versions"."rights_statement" IS NULL) = ("media_versions"."rights_stated_by" IS NULL) AND ("media_versions"."rights_statement" IS NULL) = ("media_versions"."rights_stated_at" IS NULL)

media_versions_description_check.name: media_versions_description_check
media_versions_description_check.value: "media_versions"."description" IS NULL OR length("media_versions"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

media_versions_publishable_check.name: media_versions_publishable_check
media_versions_publishable_check.value: "media_versions"."published_at" IS NULL OR ("media_versions"."licence_name" IS NOT NULL AND (NOT "media_versions"."credit_required" OR "media_versions"."credit_name" IS NOT NULL) AND "media_versions"."rights_statement" IS NOT NULL AND "media_versions"."rights_statement" IN ('v1_own', 'v1_authorised'))

player_counters_nonnegative_check.name: player_counters_nonnegative_check
player_counters_nonnegative_check.value:
"player_counters"."trips_completed" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."flights_completed" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."correct_flights" >= 0
        AND "player_counters"."all_correct_trips" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."miles_earned" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."best_trip_streak" >= 0
        AND "player_counters"."identifier_full_trips" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."perfect_flight_streak" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."best_perfect_flight_streak" >= 0
        AND "player_counters"."hint_free_trip_streak" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."best_hint_free_trip_streak" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."night_trips" >= 0
        AND "player_counters"."go_arounds" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."flights_on_last_played_date" >= 0 AND "player_counters"."day_streak" >= 0
        AND "player_counters"."best_day_streak" >= 0

rounds_completed_has_award_check.name: rounds_completed_has_award_check
rounds_completed_has_award_check.value:
"rounds"."status" <> 'completed'
        OR ("rounds"."completion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rounds"."sp_awarded" IS NOT NULL AND "rounds"."miles_awarded" IS NOT NULL)

store_products_kind_rule_check.name: store_products_kind_rule_check
store_products_kind_rule_check.value: ("store_products"."kind" = 'hint_pack' AND "store_products"."hints" IS NOT NULL AND "store_products"."hints" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "store_products"."miles" IS NULL AND "store_products"."pass_period" IS NULL) OR ("store_products"."kind" = 'miles_pack' AND "store_products"."miles" IS NOT NULL AND "store_products"."miles" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND "store_products"."hints" IS NULL AND "store_products"."pass_period" IS NULL) OR ("store_products"."kind" = 'first_class_pass' AND "store_products"."hints" IS NULL AND "store_products"."miles" IS NULL AND "store_products"."pass_period" IS NOT NULL)

store_transactions_kind_rule_check.name: store_transactions_kind_rule_check
store_transactions_kind_rule_check.value: ("store_transactions"."kind" = 'hint_pack' AND "store_transactions"."granted_hints" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_miles" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_until" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."original_ref" IS NULL) OR ("store_transactions"."kind" = 'miles_pack' AND "store_transactions"."granted_miles" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_hints" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_until" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."original_ref" IS NULL) OR ("store_transactions"."kind" = 'first_class_pass' AND "store_transactions"."granted_hints" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_miles" IS NULL AND "store_transactions"."granted_until" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transactions"."original_ref" IS NOT NULL)
